items.name: Orange (whole citrus fruit, sweet orange or mandarin-type)
items.preparation: raw, whole fruit, unpeeled, single piece on plate

scale_cues: Plate used as scale: the white square plate is roughly 20-25 cm across, and the orange spans about one-third of its width, which suggests a fruit about 6-7 cm in diameter. No hand or cutlery visible for further reference.
assumptions: Only one food item is visible: a single whole orange-colored citrus fruit on a white square plate. No sauces, dressings, oils, garnishes, or drinks are visible.

The fruit could be a sweet orange or a mandarin/tangerine; the orange color and size are consistent with either. Identity confidence is moderate, and the USDA entry for mandarins would give slightly different values.
grams_best is the estimated edible flesh mass, about 70-75% of a whole fruit of roughly 140-150 g; peel is excluded.
Plate diameter is assumed to be about 20-25 cm for the scale estimate.
The image is a single overhead frame, so the fruit's density and exact size cannot be verified.
